progression.zh-CN: 先在稳定可控的行程内达到次数上限，再小幅调整徒手动作难度，例如墙面俯卧撑的站位；每次只改一项，并保持约2–3次余力。动作控制变差时回退难度或减少一组。有氧先以可持续的谈话强度完成当前时间；适应且恢复良好后，在可用时长内少量增加分钟数，不同时提高强度。若需更多周有氧量，另行安排时间，不挤掉热身或抗阻组间休息。
progression.en: Reach the rep ceiling through a stable controlled range before adjusting a bodyweight variation, such as stance distance for wall push-ups. Change one thing at a time and keep about 2–3 reps in reserve. Regress difficulty or remove a set if control declines. For aerobic work, first complete the current duration at a sustainable conversational effort. Once comfortable and recovering well, add a few minutes within available time without also increasing intensity. Schedule extra weekly aerobic time separately rather than cutting warm-up or resistance rest.

warmup.zh-CN: 每次先轻松骑行5分钟，结束前再轻松骑行数分钟；都计入30分钟总时长。
warmup.en: Start with 5 minutes of easy pedaling and finish with a few easy minutes; both count toward the 30-minute session budget.

progression.zh-CN: 先以可持续的谈话强度完成每次20分钟，必要时缩短并分段。适应且恢复良好后，在30分钟总时长内少量增加骑行分钟数，保留热身与轻松收尾，不同时提高强度；超过预算的有氧量另行安排。恢复不佳时缩短时间或降低强度。
progression.en: First build toward 20 minutes at a sustainable conversational effort; shorten or split it if needed. Once comfortable and recovering well, add a few minutes within the 30-minute session budget, keeping warm-up and an easy finish. Do not also increase intensity; schedule additional duration separately. Reduce duration or intensity if recovery is poor.
